name: Carter
title: The Wagon Yard
examine: The High Road's last league is a descent, a crag corner, and a gate, in that order, and every carter at this fire has opinions about all three.
lines: Never again, that road. See you next month.
Grain up, ingots down. The road only rhymes if you're paid both ways.
Torvald looked at my axle, sucked his teeth, and named a price. You don't argue with the teeth. The teeth have seen things.
